LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Custom highlights panel with round image and configurable fields/actions. Works on Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead, Order, Contract, Quote - can display the current record or its parent Account (recordSource property).

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls button labels (Edit / Modifier, View Account Hierarchy / Voir la hiérarchie) and empty-state messages.

property.name: recordSource
property.label: Record source
property.description: current = show the record on the current page. parent = show the linked Account (Contact/Opportunity/Case/Order/Contract/Quote/Lead) or the Parent Account (when on an Account page).

property.name: accountFieldsList
property.label: Account - fields to display (comma-separated)
property.description: Used when the displayed record is an Account.

property.name: contactFieldsList
property.label: Contact - fields to display (comma-separated)
property.description: Used when the displayed record is a Contact.

property.name: imageFieldApiName
property.label: Image URL field API name (optional)
property.description: Optional. API name of a text/URL field on the current object holding an image URL (e.g. a custom ImageURL__c). If present, takes priority over the File-based image. Leave empty to rely on the built-in File storage - the component uploads the replacement as a standard File on the record, no custom schema required.

property.name: imageSize
property.label: Image size (px)
property.description: Diameter of the round image in pixels. Also sets the fallback icon circle size.

property.name: disableImageReplace
property.label: Disable click-to-replace image
property.description: Off by default - clicking the image opens a file picker and uploads the new image as a standard File on the record. Turn ON to restore the legacy 'open image full size' behavior.

property.name: maxQuickActions
property.label: Max quick actions
property.description: Number of buttons displayed in the header. Picked from the active page layout's actions list (same source as the standard Highlights Panel).

property.name: quickActionsCsv
property.label: Quick actions override (API names, comma-separated)
property.description: Optional. Forces a specific list instead of the page-layout default. Leave empty to use the layout.
